# Rankur (rankursite.com)

> Founder-led B2B web engineering, technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) consultancy led by Moksh Parjapati.

Rankur (https://rankursite.com) builds custom Next.js and React web platforms, technical SEO architectures, and GEO strategies for B2B companies and mission-driven organisations, with 100% source code ownership and zero vendor lock-in.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://rankursite.com/): Overview of Next.js web engineering, technical SEO, and GEO services.
- [Services](https://rankursite.com/services): B2B lead generation, Next.js engineering, technical SEO, and CRO services.
- [B2B SaaS Websites](https://rankursite.com/saas-websites): Custom React and Next.js web platforms for B2B SaaS teams.
- [Case Studies](https://rankursite.com/case-studies): Production web architecture breakdown, including Wafa Educational & Charitable Trust (https://www.wafatrustindia.org/).
- [About](https://rankursite.com/about): Founder profile for Moksh Parjapati.
- [Free B2B Audit](https://rankursite.com/free-audit): Technical SEO and inbound pipeline diagnostic request.
- [Contact](https://rankursite.com/contact): Business inquiries (contactus@rankursite.com).
